name: Uptime Kuma
description: Watches your sites and services and alerts you when one goes down. Beautiful status pages.
compose:
services:
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:3001"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}:/app/data
